_comment: Milestone P3: the mapping bench in the nodal view. An LFO stands in for the sensor, a Range Filter conditions it once, and three branches take that same conditioned value: straight to a signal display, through Smooth to a value display, and through Multi-choice to a third. Badges match walkthrough steps 1 (the emulated input), 4 (conditioning done once, centrally), 6 (the smoothed branch), 7 (the stepped branch), and 8 (observation on each).
